articles.title: Tinto Brass obituary
articles.summary: Italian director drawn to the erotic best known for his 1979 film Caligula, which is now regarded as a cult favourite

articles.title: 13 Assassins: Takashi Miike’s viscerally violent remake is full-throttle samurai mayhem
articles.summary: The Japanese film-maker doesn’t hold back in his rendition of the 1963 film, with an epic battle that remains one of the most impressive action scenes in history

articles.title: Whispers in the Woods review – paddling in the moonlight in tender study of human-animal interaction
articles.summary: Director Vincent Munier takes his father and son into the Vosges forest in France and finds lynx, serene foxes and deer

articles.title: Traces of Justice review – ‘Chinese Sherlock Holmes’ at centre of arresting forensic cop thriller
articles.summary: Based on real scientist Cui Daozhi, this sharp feature has thumping set pieces and knotty puzzles set across 30 years of gripping cases

articles.title: ‘I’m looking for faces which surprise me’: how Richard Avedon photographed the soul of his subjects
articles.summary: Ron Howard’s illuminating Netflix documentary looks back on the career of one of America’s most inventive and versatile photographers

articles.title: Soul Patrol review – heartstopping story of the US army’s first Black special ops team at work in Vietnam
articles.summary: Based on a 2003 memoir, this remarkable documentary shows the incredible bravery these young men showed in the face of battle and unrelenting bigotry

articles.title: Donnie Dunagan, original voice of Disney’s Bambi and triple Purple Heart marine, dies aged 92
articles.summary: Dunagan was six when he voiced the young deer in the classic cartoon, with an assistant director instructing him to pretend his own mother had died

articles.title: 1 in 2 review – compassionate film about dealing with bowel cancer is a personal plea on behalf of the young
articles.summary: David Wilkinson made this warm, generous documentary of his own treatment, and asks why so many much younger people are getting the same diagnosis
